percentile: nearest rank; median averages middle pair
note: Main Thread, PlayerLoop and wait-marker costs overlap; never sum or subtract them as exclusive CPU work. Invalid counters stay invalid. Moving-count summaries exclude the first collected row because the raw transition reference was initialized before warmup; only that row can include warmup displacement. Timing, GC and other counters retain all samples. Body visibility can change due to interpolation. Pair equality checks fixed input/model duration and aggregate logical workload, not product state identity. Missing runs and workloads must be reviewed before a pass claim. Total GC is not isolated interpolation GC.
